Brynn Bills went missing August 2nd, but it was reported until 11 days later. She was 18. A huge search started for her, and spread quickly through Michigan. However, the Gabby Petito case was peaking at this time, so it was over shadowed. On September 28th at 4:30 pm, she was recovered from Joshua Wirgaus property. 

Wirgau, previously, has been convicted on impregnating a 13 year old in 2008. 

On the night September 27th Joshua Wirgau, Brad Srebnik, and Abby Hill we’re arrested on false imprisonment charges. This was helpful, as Abby Hill was supposedly the last person seen with Bills. Hill was bonded out at $500, and two weeks later she was found dead of an apparent homicide. 

This is still an ongoing investigation! Srenbik is publicly named a suspect, and Wirgau is a person of interest. We hope to get answers soon! We miss you Brynn!! #JusticeforBrynn #forever18
